name: catalyst-ops
description: How Catalyst Shift operates (HOW_WE_BUILD v2). Three skills: next (the pickup loop for Kevin or Keith, whoever runs it — top Linear card → build → in-session adversarial pass → /ship, or in a repo with changelog.d/ fragments the repo's own PR step, with auto-merge on → next card, 650k context budget, handoff for a fresh session), ways-of-working (three homes + the build method: /next, adversarial review as a required check, auto-merge on everything, recommend-ask-proceed with hard stops), and decision-governance (proposed-vs-decided labelling, ratification rules). The verify skill and verify-gate hook are retired (the CI adversarial review replaces them). Behavior only; canon content stays in the strategy doc and docs/HOW_WE_BUILD.md.
